description: This file defines the LocationSync plugin class for the WPEFramework, including its nested classes for data management, notification handling, and configuration. It declares interfaces, methods, and class structures related to location synchronization functionality.

classes.name: LocationSync
classes.description: Main plugin class implementing location synchronization, IWeb, and JSONRPC interfaces. Manages initialization, configuration, event handling, and location data retrieval.

nested_classes.name: Data
nested_classes.description: JSON container for location data including IP, timezone, region, country, and city.

nested_classes.name: Notification
nested_classes.description: Handles location change notifications, probing location services, and dispatching location updates.

nested_classes.name: Config
nested_classes.description: JSON container for plugin configuration parameters such as interval, retries, and source.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the plugin with the given shell service.

methods.name: Deinitialize
methods.description: Deinitializes and cleans up plugin resources.

methods.name: Process
methods.description: Processes web requests and generates responses.

methods.name: RegisterAll
methods.description: Registers all plugin endpoints or handlers.

methods.name: UnregisterAll
methods.description: Unregisters all plugin endpoints or handlers.
